content.user_title: Plan a compliant B2B outreach sequence
content.value_statement: Cold outreach plans can miss reply handling, sending limits, and jurisdiction requirements. This skill creates a structured sequence plan with deliverability and compliance guardrails before copy is written.
actual_capabilities: Maps multi-step B2B outreach sequences with timing, goals, and exit rules.
Routes positive replies, objections, referrals, deferrals, and opt-outs to next actions.
Creates estimated mailbox warmup ramps and daily sending caps.
Flags CAN-SPAM elements and jurisdiction-specific consent questions.
Reviews sender-integrity evidence such as authentication, bounce, and complaint status.
Creates a handoff summary for consent, creative, and quality-review workflows.
limitations: It does not send email, access email platforms, or validate live mailbox settings.
It provides operational compliance guidance, not legal advice.
It does not create or adjudicate consent records.
It does not write final email copy or calculate a final quality score.

use_cases.title: Launch a new outbound motion
use_cases.description: Create a staged outreach plan and mailbox ramp before a sales team begins sending.

use_cases.title: Standardize reply handling
use_cases.description: Define clear next actions for common replies so representatives stop outreach at the right time.

use_cases.title: Assess a purchased list
use_cases.description: Identify missing jurisdiction and lawful-basis information before planning a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a five-step B2B cold-outreach sequence for IT directors at mid-sized manufacturers. Include timing, goals, and exit rules.

prompt_templates.title: Add reply routing
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reply-triage branching for our B2B outreach. Route positive replies, objections, referrals, not-now replies, and opt-outs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan warmup limits
prompt_templates.prompt: I have three new mailboxes on a new domain. Create an estimated weekly warmup ramp and daily sending caps.

prompt_templates.title: Review a campaign plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this B2B outbound plan for sender-integrity gaps, opt-out handling, list jurisdiction risks, and missing evidence. Return NEEDS_INPUT where evidence is absent.

output_examples.input: Build a sequence for finance leaders at software companies.
output: Step 1: Introduce the relevant business problem and exit on any reply.
Step 2: Send a short follow-up after four business days.
Stop all outreach immediately after an opt-out, bounce, or positive reply.

output_examples.input: Plan warmup for two new mailboxes.
output: Week 1: Start with a low estimated daily volume per mailbox.
Increase only when authentication, bounce, and complaint signals remain acceptable.
Keep a steady-state daily cap and distribute volume across both mailboxes.

best_practices: Provide the target jurisdiction, list source, mailbox setup, and known sending metrics.
Use hard exit rules for replies, opt-outs, and bounces in every sequence step.
Send consent and legal questions to the responsible records and legal-review process.
anti_patterns: Do not continue outreach after an opt-out, bounce, or direct reply.
Do not treat missing consent or jurisdiction information as approval to send.
Do not use estimated warmup volumes as proof of safe deliverability.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It creates a sequence plan and guardrails only.

faq.question: Can it write email copy?
faq.answer: No. It plans steps and reply routes. Use a copywriting workflow for message text.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It flags operational requirements and recommends confirmation with qualified counsel.

faq.question: Can it approve a prospect list?
faq.answer: No. It identifies missing lawful-basis and jurisdiction information for review.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the ideal customer profile, list source, sending setup, target jurisdictions, and available sending metrics.

faq.question: What happens when data is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks relevant items as NEEDS_INPUT or Unknown instead of inventing a result.
